'''Susanne Ditlevsen''' (born 1965)<ref name="Højgaard-2024">{{cite web |last=Højgaard |first=Liselotte |title=Tagea Brandt's travel grant to Susanne Ditlevsen |url=https://www.math.ku.dk/english/about/news/tagea-brandts-travel-grant-to-susanne-ditlevsen/ |website=[[University of Copenhagen]] |access-date=7 April 2026 |date=19 April 2024}}</ref> is a Danish mathematician and statistician, interested in [[mathematical biology]], [[perception]], [[dynamical system]]s, and [[Biostatistics|statistical modeling of biological systems]].<ref name="Zhong-2023">{{Cite news |last=Zhong |first=Raymond |date=2023-07-25 |title=Warming Could Push the Atlantic Past a 'Tipping Point' This Century |language=en-US |work=[[The New York Times]] |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2023/07/25/climate/atlantic-ocean-tipping-point.html |access-date=2023-07-25 |issn=0362-4331}}</ref> She is a professor in the Department of Mathematical Sciences of the [[University of Copenhagen]], where she heads the section of statistics and probability theory.

==Early life==
Ditlevsen was born in Denmark. She graduated from {{ill|Det frie Gymnasium|da}} in 1983. She was an actress before she became a researcher.<ref name="Højgaard-2024" />

==Career==
Ditlevsen earned a master's degree in mathematics from the [[National University of Distance Education]] in Spain in 1999. The following year, she earned a master's degree in statistics from the [[University of Copenhagen]]. In 2004, she received a Ph.D. from the University of Copenhagen with the dissertation ''Modeling of physiological processes by stochastic differential equations''.<ref name="Højgaard-2024" />

After receiving her Ph.D., Ditlevsen became a professor in the Department of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen in 2011.<ref name="Højgaard-2024" /> In 2012, she became an elected member of the [[International Statistical Institute]], and in 2016, she was elected to the [[Royal Danish Academy of Sciences and Letters]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Individual Members |url=https://isi-web.org/index.php/about-isi/who-is-isi/members/indivual |website=[[International Statistical Institute]] |access-date=7 April 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151106162416/https://isi-web.org/index.php/about-isi/who-is-isi/members/indivual |archive-date=6 November 2015 |url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Two mathematicians elected to the Academy of Science |url=https://www.math.ku.dk/english/about/news/academy_16/ |website=[[University of Copenhagen]] |access-date=7 April 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181206102248/https://www.math.ku.dk/english/about/news/academy_16/ |archive-date=6 December 2018 |date=2 May 2016 |url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2023, she and her brother Peter, a climate scientist, published an article predicting that the [[Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation]] has a chance of collapsing between 2025 and 2095 (95% confidence interval), with the statistical average of the predictions being 2057 (updated in August 2025 to between 2037 and 2109, with average of 2065).<ref name="Ditlevsen2023">{{Cite journal |last1=Ditlevsen |first1=Peter |last2=Ditlevsen |first2=Susanne |date=2023-07-25 |title=Warning of a forthcoming collapse of the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation |journal=[[Nature Communications]] |language=en |volume=14 |issue=1 |pages=4254 |doi=10.1038/s41467-023-39810-w  |doi-access=free|pmid=37491344 |issn=2041-1723|pmc=10368695 |arxiv=2304.09160 |bibcode=2023NatCo..14.4254D }}</ref> When this tipping point is reached, it will have severe consequences to the world's climate, especially of northern Europe (see [[Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation#Effects of AMOC slowdown|Effects of AMOC slowdown]]).<ref name="Zhong-2023" />

==Personal life==
Her niece is actress [[Sara Hjort Ditlevsen]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Skarum |first=Sarah |title="Jeg kan godt se, hvor gammel jeg er. Men så gammel er jeg jo også" |url=https://politiken.dk/navne/art10317331/%C2%BBJeg-kan-godt-se-hvor-gammel-jeg-er.-Men-s%C3%A5-gammel-er-jeg-jo-ogs%C3%A5%C2%AB |url-access=subscription |website=[[Politiken]] |access-date=6 April 2026 |language=da |date=18 March 2025}}</ref>
